title: plan-activation-residency
summary: Propose training activation and gradient memory reductions by distinguishing lifetime reordering, address packing and selective rematerialization from supplied evidence.

skill_metadata.name: plan-activation-residency
skill_metadata.description: Propose training activation and gradient memory reductions by distinguishing lifetime reordering, address packing and selective rematerialization from supplied evidence.

applicability.scope: Proposing training activation and gradient memory reductions when pressure appears to come from live tensors or allocator-reserved memory, by distinguishing lifetime reordering, address packing and selective rematerialization; covers activation checkpointing for recomputation, not persistent recovery checkpoints
applicability.prerequisites: The packaged evidence and limits are read before citing paper results; installing or running a solver or framework, modifying allocation or checkpoint policies, reproducing workloads or provisioning hardware needs separate authorization
applicability.input_contract: The actual forward/backward/update DAG, shapes and precision, tensor sizes and consumer lifetimes; resident versus reserved peak bytes; operator, workspace and temporary-output peaks; batch and accumulation policy; optimizer and collective barriers; representative compute and transfer costs; whether the goal is fit, step time or time to a fixed training objective
applicability.produced_artifact: A preferred candidate, simpler fallback, resource ledger, critical-path prediction, assumptions, counter-signals and unresolved-evidence list, with source claims kept apart from proposed decisions, plus a proposed matched comparison; a reviewable proposal, not an implementation
failure_modes: Fragmentation and live-byte excess are not distinguished at the same phase
OLLA address packing is read as tensor placement across CPU/SSD tiers
Reordering moves a release or update past a dependency such as shared weights, accumulation, gradient clipping, optimizer state or collectives
A static packing plan ignores alignment, aliasing, workspace, asynchronous overlap or shape variability
Added recomputation consumes the compute window that previously hid transfers
Checkmate's rounding is taken to guarantee the memory cap, or its 10% allowance is used as a portable safety margin
A solver timeout is read as proof of infeasibility
applicability.refusal_point: Returns the missing classification instead of a preferred checkpoint interval when only total OOM memory is known, and escalates when a legal dependency graph, memory margin or correctness model is unavailable

recommendations: Where ordering is legal, try earlier last-use and gradient release before adding computation or transfer.
Check dependency validity and memory feasibility separately for an approximate schedule.
Account for planning cost over the expected number of repeated steps.
limitations: Source-derived candidate; no local efficacy validation.
Original typed source inventory is not normalized; retain source identities and limits in the procedure/readsets.
